ballPolicy: The basketball remains separate game art. Leo’s empty right fingertips touch the floor at frame3/tick7 to retrieve it; the ball is never drawn into the poses.

review.reviewNotes: Five distinct full-body right-facing poses show a controlled low reach, ground contact at frame3/tick7, and composed recovery. Leo remains pale, adult and human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache and black/crimson kit. All hands are empty; no ball is drawn.
